audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted their own why text: Level 6 read Tryndamere while whys[4] calls it Ornn's cleanest all-in; first item read Ornn while whys[5] says 'It evens out'; 2+ items read Ornn while whys[6] says he reclaims the duel with Infinity Edge.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1 — long enough that the level-6 window belongs to whoever forces the fight while it is down, and Ornn's CC chain is what makes that possible. Late, crit scaling plus a 5-second death immunity beats a single-target combo. The packet chart agrees on all three.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Ornn, first item -> Skill, 2+ items -> Tryndamere, matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; Level 6 said only that 'Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math'.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s, Bloodlust 12s, Mocking Shout 14s, Spinning Slash 12s at rank 1. The 120s ult cooldown is the single most actionable number in the matchup because it defines when Ornn is allowed to commit.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to phases[4].why, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout was never mentioned on the page at all, and Battle Fury/Bloodlust's wounded-scaling was never stated.
audit.why: Riot text, W: 'decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.' The slow is conditional on facing away — which means disengaging from Tryndamere by running is the one thing that triggers it, and walking toward him does not. That is the concrete positioning rule this page was missing. Riot text, Q: his Attack Damage increases as he is more wounded, so a low Tryndamere is the dangerous one, not the finished one.
audit.corrected: Back-turned condition stated in tldr and report[5].t; wounded-scaling in dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was named as important but never attributed or timed.
audit.why: The flagged missing interaction is Bloodlust — a 12s, zero-cost heal that consumes Fury he generates from every attack and crit. Ornn's whole pattern is chip plus Brittle, which Bloodlust refunds on a 12s clock unless Grievous Wounds exists.
audit.corrected: report[8] now names Bloodlust and its 12s cooldown; phases[5].why states the refund as the reason the first-item window is even rather than won.

edits.before: Anti-heal his crits — W-brittle, out-last his R. Ornn wins the Undying Rage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Never turn your back — Mocking Shout only slows a fleeing target. Anti-heal Bloodlust, then Brittle.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1. Bait it or fight while it is down — your R chains a knock-up onto a champion whose only escape is Spinning Slash.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Undying Rage's cooldown.
edits.after: Even window: your tank item bullies him, but he farms safely and Bloodlust refunds your chip.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Tryndamere carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Tryndamere reclaims the duel with crit items, and Battle Fury gives him more crit the longer he fights. Do not 1v1 him.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s at rank 1. Bait it, or fight only once it has been spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His AD rises as his health falls — a low Tryndamere is the dangerous one.

edits.before: Track Tryndamere's Undying Rage: Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Mocking Shout slows only enemies with their backs turned — walk toward him, never away.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — bait it before you commit. - Bloodlust: 12s, and it heals off his Fury. - Mocking Shout: 14s, 850 range — it cuts your AD and slows you only if you turn away.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps. Bloodlust heals off Fury every 12s — Grievous Wounds is not optional here.

notes: I did not repeat the page's existing '5s' figure for Undying Rage's duration — the duration is not in Riot's ability text and needsResearch is empty, so I replaced it with the 120s cooldown, which is verified. The old string stays accurate-looking elsewhere; I neither confirmed nor contradicted it. Spinning Slash carries no dash flag in the kit despite being a movement ability, so I did not claim Ornn's Q grounding denies it — that question is recorded for the user. UNVERIFIED and untouched: 'unstoppable percent-HP poke and a shield' for Bellows Breath (whys[2], spikes[1], early, wants.you[0]); and per the Tahm Kench and Trundle mirrors, 'R double knock-up' in whys[4]/spikes[2]/wants.you[1] overstates the cast — only the recast knocks up.
